title: Phase 4 Missed Gunshot Events & Low-SNR Acoustic Investigation

investigation_summary.root_cause_of_7_misses: Manifest duplicate indexing collision in evaluate_event_level.py
investigation_summary.artifact_explanation: In Phase 3, evaluate_event_level.py loaded gunshot_events.csv using a dictionary keyed by base_stem. Four test recordings had multiple duplicate files in raw data (e.g. filename (1).mp3, (2).mp3). Each duplicate row was appended to events_by_stem[base_stem], producing 24 annotated events across 17 test recordings. The detector ran on the single primary test file and detected the physical event (TP=17), but the 7 duplicate entries remained unmatched under strict 1-to-1 matching and were counted as FN=7.
investigation_summary.genuine_acoustic_challenge_identified: While all 17 physical gunshot events triggered alerts, several individual low-SNR windows (late reverberation tails and distant shots) scored between 0.15 and 0.54, falling below the 0.55 threshold. Phase 4 addresses this via low-SNR data augmentation, hysteresis thresholding, and source-balanced training.

phase3_missed_events_detailed_audit.root_cause_explanation: Duplicate raw recording file 'freesound_community-gun-shots-from-a-distance-19-96417 (2).mp3' sharing base stem 'freesound_community-gun-shots-from-a-distance-19-96417' was annotated independently in gunshot_events.csv. When evaluating the single deduplicated test file, events_by_stem[freesound_community-gun-shots-from-a-distance-19-96417] contained 4 duplicate ground-truth entries for the exact same physical gunshot at t=[0.015s - 1.795s]. The detector correctly fired an alert for the gunshot (score=0.8658 >= 0.55), matching ground truth #1. Because match_events enforces strict 1-to-1 matching, duplicate entry #2 had no remaining unmatched detection and was erroneously tallied as a missed gunshot (FN). The physical audio was actually detected with high confidence.
phase3_missed_events_detailed_audit.action_taken: Deduplicate ground truth events by (primary_file, event_index) so that each physical event is evaluated exactly once without phantom inflation.

low_snr_trailing_windows_audit.diagnosis: Late reverberation decay / low acoustic energy. The onset window fired the alert, but the trailing window dissipated into environmental noise (SNR < 15 dB), dropping below the 0.55 classification threshold.
